description: Selector resolution depends on every key between the selector anchor and the resolved key: an insert anywhere in that span changes what the selector resolves to, but Bedrock records only the resolved key (hit) or nothing (miss). FDB's getKeyAndConflictRange registers [resolved, anchor) for offset<=0 and [anchor, keyAfter(resolved)) for offset>0, post-resolution. Spike on temp worktree off PR #109 branch; fresh-agent audit before folding into #109. Parent context: bedrock-udr.
title: Spike: key-selector reads must record scanned-span read conflicts (FDB extraConflictRanges)
